qs.q: What is the primary function of the Mother and Child Health Booklet in Kenya during a well-child visit?
o: To serve as the child's official birth certificate and national identity document
To hold the birth details, immunisation record, growth chart, and development milestones
To provide prescriptions for common childhood antibiotics and antimalarials
To document family land ownership and socioeconomic status for health subsidies
qs.e: The Mother and Child Health Booklet acts as the child's record, holding birth details, the immunisation record, growth charts, developmental milestones, and vitamin A dates. It is not used as a national identity document or land title deed.
qs.s: Evaluation of the Well Child: Surveillance, Screening, Immunisation and Guidance

qs.q: Which academic institution is primarily associated with the Department of Child Health and Paediatrics through the authors and contributors of the text?
o: Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology
qs.e: The text explicitly acknowledges the Department of Child Health and Paediatrics at Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology (JKUAT) as the primary home institution of the lead authors. Other universities like the University of Nairobi are only mentioned in relation to specific external reviewers or registrars.

qs.q: Who is credited as the Senior Lecturer and Founding Chair of the Department of Child Health and Paediatrics at JKUAT?
qs.e: Dr. Patrick M. Mburugu is listed as the Senior Lecturer and Founding Chair of the Department of Child Health and Paediatrics at JKUAT. The other individuals hold different roles such as surgeons or professors elsewhere.
